messages:
Samir Patel: FYI Contoso's auditor posted a formal SOC2 evidence request re: the auth outage on 2025-11-12. They want chain-of-custody for the rotation event: KMS rotation logs, HSM attestation + cert chain, access-log slices showing service principal activity and API token hashes, retention policy proof, and reproducible steps for the 401 spike.

Maria Gomez: Thanks Samir. Tagging @Josh and @Lena — can one of you own collection + repro script? Auditor explicitly asked for native artifact links (no screenshots).

Josh Lin: I can own gateway log slices and a minimal repro. Quick Q for the auditor: do you need the full HSM attestation package or just the onboarding cert and serial? @Contoso Auditor

Contoso Auditor: Hi team — we need the HSM attestation that ties the HSM serial to the cert chain used at the time of rotation, plus evidence the same device performed the rotate. KMS rotation timeline (who/when), and a few signed request samples showing the KeyID that failed. Also a manifest listing files you provide.

Lena Volkova: Got it. I'll extract rotation audit trail (CloudKMS + internal keystore) and CMK metadata. Josh — what exact window should we slice for gateway logs?

Josh Lin: Pager window per incident: 2025-11-12T03:10:00Z -> 2025-11-12T03:35:00Z. There was a rebound around 03:48Z. I'll export 03:00-04:00 to be safe. Will redact raw tokens and include token hashes (sha256) and service_principal IDs.

Maria Gomez: For retention proof, attach the official policy file at security/retention/policies/keystore-retention.md plus the active S3 lifecycle rule JSON. Auditor needs TTLs and last-modified timestamps.

Josh Lin: Draft repro steps (for evidence bundle):
```
# reproduce auth 401 after CMK rotation (simulation)
# steps:
# 1) simulate CMK rotate via admin API
# 2) create JWT signed with previous key material
# 3) call POST /v1/generate with the old-signed token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-sig>" -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -v
```
I'll include tracer IDs and matching gateway logs in the bundle.

audit-bot: note: include chain-of-custody manifest (CSV) with fields: filename, sha256, pulled_by, pulled_at, source_path. Provide an S3 inventory CSV for the evidence bundle and sign the manifest.

Maria Gomez: Agreed. We'll include a signed manifest and track who pulled each artifact. I'll sign with org key and upload the final bundle.

Lena Volkova: KMS rotation log excerpt (preview):
```
2025-11-12T03:06:42Z rotate_request user=ops@redwood id=cmk-0a1b2c
2025-11-12T03:07:09Z rotate_start key=cmk-0a1b2c worker=keymgr-3
2025-11-12T03:07:22Z rotate_complete key=cmk-0a1b2c method=hsm-rotate cert_serial=HSM12345
```
I'll include the full audit trail and HSM attestation bundle.

Contoso Auditor: Also provide an IAM policy snapshot proving rotate endpoints are restricted and an actor list of accounts that performed role-based actions during rotation.

Josh Lin: I'll attach iam/policies/keystore-rotation.json and iam/activity/2025-11-12-rotate-actors.csv in the evidence bundle.

Maria Gomez: Owners & deadlines: @Josh — logs + repro by EOD today. @Lena — KMS/HSM artifacts by 12:00PM tomorrow. I'll assemble the manifest, retention docs, and upload when both are ready.

Contoso Auditor: That timeline is acceptable. Final request: include a 1-2 paragraph plain-English reproduction summary to include in the package.

Samir Patel: Once uploaded, post the pre-signed S3 bundle link here plus the manifest SHA256. I'll handle auditor follow-ups.

Josh Lin: Uploaded partial bundle to internal S3: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2025-11-12/auth-outage/part1_logs_repro_v1.tar.gz (pre-signed link sent to auditor via secure channel). Manifest SHA256: 3f2a9b8c4d5e6f7a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2

Contoso Auditor: Link received, verification started. May ask for small clarifications after checksum validation. Thank you.

Maria Gomez: Noted. Marking action items in the SOC2 tracker and linking the evidence bundle to the SOC2 Google Drive folder. :thumbsup:
